name: XO Elotes

ingredients.name: finely crumbled Cotija cheese, plus more for serving

instructions.primary_message: Light 1 chimney full of charcoal. When all charcoal is lit and covered with gray ash, pour out and spread coals evenly over half of coal grate. Alternatively, set half the burners of a gas grill to high heat. Set cooking grate in place, cover grill, and allow to preheat for 5 minutes. Clean and oil grilling grate.

Meanwhile, combine cheese, mayonnaise, sour cream or crema, XO sauce, scallions, garlic, lime zest, and ground chilies (if using) in a large bowl. Using a flexible spatula, stir together until homogenous; set aside.
When grill is hot, place corn directly over hot side of grill and cook, rotating occasionally, until cooked through and charred in spots on all sides, about 8 minutes total.

Transfer corn to bowl with cheese mixture and use a large spoon to evenly coat corn on all sides with mixture. Sprinkle with extra cheese and ground chiles (if using) and serve immediately with lime wedges.

description: This recipe riffs on rich and creamy grilled Mexican street corn with the addition of savory, meaty XO sauce.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Pinch finely ground dried Thai chilies, plus more for serving (optional; see note)

Optional substitutions: finely crumbled Cotija cheese → feta cheese; sour cream → Mexican crema

Notes: XO sauce packs a healthy amount of spicy background heat on its own, but an extra pinch of ground dried chilies will give the mayonnaise mixture more punch. Adjust the heat level of the sauce to your liking.

Make-ahead and storage: This dish is best enjoyed immediately. The mayonnaise mixture can be made ahead, and refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 2 days.
author: Sasha Marx
